title: China PPI, NBS
description: Producer prices of industrial products (with means of production and consumer goods and their groups), purchasing prices (9 groups) and PPI by industry; y/y, YTD and m/m as published by NBS, from 1993. Pipeline file data/cn/ppi/cn_ppi_dash.csv.
schedule: Replaced after each NBS release by the refresh scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals (once dev-cn is merged).
